61.s: Julian Koenig's brother Les, later of Contemporary Records, played Armstrong's OKeh and Hot Five records and changed his opinion of Armstrong. Disc jockeys like Martin Block played some Armstrong and Waller, but Black bands were seldom heard.
61.ch: Yale, Stearns and the big bands

I think that the availability of musicians who were run out of… who defected from various countries in Europe who we were at war with, coming here and being able to teach in colleges, and being able to work with the symphony orchestras, the fact that Stravinsky was hired by…

855.t: Discovering jazz in 1954 through George Lewis books and American bands

744.t: Radio music and early saxophone heroes in New Orleans

I’ll say blues music it included artists like Dinah Washington, you know she sang blues but you know she was just a great singer. And I heard Louis Jordan and well all blues artists, T-Bone Walker, B.B. King. My father was an…

549.t: Ross Russell staying in the apartment
